title: Remote Control Project Kickoff Meeting
summary: Laura led the kickoff meeting for the design of a new remote control. Following team introductions, participants engaged in a brief icebreaker activity on the whiteboard. The group reviewed financial parameters, targeting an international retail price of €25 and a maximum production cost of €12.50. Initial product concepts were brainstormed, including multi-device compatibility, modern aesthetics, and locator features. Team members then separated to work on their respective functional areas prior to reconvening thirty minutes later.
topics: Individual task assignments for the next phase
decisions: Target selling price set at €25 with a production cost ceiling of €12.50 (50%).

Determine technical functions and user interface requirements
Define marketing requirements and product positioning
